text:
Jordan: Customer reports sudden 400s from /v1/call after proxy upgrade — worked yesterday.
Maya: Can you paste raw request + runtime error? model and json_mode used?
Jordan: Here’s the curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-1","json_mode":true,"function":"mark_invoices","args":{"invoice_id":"12345","confirm":true}}'
```
Jordan: Runtime: 400 parse error: "invalid structured output: args does not match function schema: expected array for 'invoice_ids'"
Maya: Schema expects invoice_ids: string[]; customer sent invoice_id. Any proxy or SDK changes recently?
Jordan: Ops rolled a small proxy normalization last night (strip nulls & flatten singletons). Proxy log:
```
[2026-02-18T02:12:09Z] proxy.normalize: flattened key invoice_ids -> invoice_id
[2026-02-18T02:12:09Z] proxy.forward request_id=trace-81a3
```
Jordan: They retried and got 401s then 429s -> they were billed for retries; customer upset about charges.
Maya: Two issues: validation failures (400) + proxy mutation causing schema drift. Need repro + mitigation.
Ingrid: Assigning eng-runtime + eng-proxy. @samir can you try reproducing with normalization rules?
Samir: Repro'ed locally with a harness. Proxy flattens arrays of length 1 into scalar and renames keys matching /^invoice_/. Example shows incoming args with invoice_id string, downstream schema expects invoice_ids array.
Samir: Fix options:
- Patch proxy to keep arrays as arrays when downstream function schema expects array.
- Runtime: accept either invoice_ids (array) or invoice_id (string) and coerce to array before validating.
Samir: I'll open PRs for both; can do runtime coercion fast.
Jordan: For now told customer to send explicit array:
```
{"args":{"invoice_ids":["12345"],"confirm":true}}
```
Maya: Also we'll credit their retry tokens — finance please hold charges until RCA.
Support-bot: Ticket #SUP-2026-114 created and linked to internal incident INC-8273 :warning:
Samir: Repro steps I ran:
1) Run proxy with normalization ruleset v1.3
2) Send JSON-mode function call with single invoice id as `invoice_id` (string)
3) Observe proxied payload shows `invoice_id` and runtime rejects against function schema expecting `invoice_ids: string[]`
Logs: `validation.failed: field invoice_ids type=expected_array got_string`
Maya: Prefer defensive runtime coercion: if schema expects array and got string, coerce to [value] and emit audit log.
Ingrid: Prioritize hotfix: revert proxy normalization rule + runtime coercion. Canary in 90m?
Samir: Yes — rollback patch and runtime coercion PR; staging canary in ~90m.
Jordan: Customer updated — applied workaround and will refund retry tokens. They want confirmation when deployed.
Maya: Action items:
- samir: PRs for proxy rollback + runtime coercion (canary ~90m)
- ingrid: monitor canary + SLA latency metrics (filter by trace id)
- jordan: billing hold + credit note
- support: keep customer updated and escalate to enterprise success if needed
Jordan: Thanks all :heart:
